Two member-diagnostic sites no longer index DeclaringSyntaxReferences[0], which is empty for metadata-only symbols. They use FirstOrDefault-based lookups that return a null location instead. The analyzer also stops running TypeCollector from [MessagePackObject] structs and only starts from classes and union interfaces. New tests compile a defining assembly to a metadata image and check that a consuming project builds with no diagnostics and gets its resolver.
